definitions.gloss: class reshuffling; regrouping (of classes or teams)
definitions.explanation: Reassigning students to new homeroom classes, usually at the start of a school year; an older word for クラス{替|が}え.

examples.japanese: ⟦{四月|しがつ}→四月：00668_shigatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{組替|くみが}えがある。
{組替|くみが}えで⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧になった。
examples.english: After the reshuffle, I ended up in a different class from my close friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二年|にねん}→二年：28862_ninen⟧ごとに{組替|くみが}えを⟦{行|おこな}い→行い：14121_okonai⟧、⟦{担任|たんにん}→担任：16408_tannin⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{替|か}わる。
examples.english: This school reshuffles classes every two years, and the homeroom teachers change too.

notes:
An older, more formal word for ⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧{替|が}え; schools and parents still use it. Also written {組|く}み{替|か}え.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧{替|が}え: the everyday word among students
- ⟦{席替|せきが}え→席替え：29987_sekigae⟧: changing seats within one class

WATCH OUT:
{組|く}み{換|か}え, written with {換|か}, means recombination, as in ⟦{遺伝子|いでんし}→遺伝子：05031_idenshi⟧{組|く}み{換|か}え (genetic modification); it is a different word.
